sdk._comment: Pinned exactly: the Web SDK injects Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets at the ASP.NET Core patch it bundles, and that version is recorded in packages.lock.json. A roll-forward to a newer SDK patch therefore breaks `dotnet restore --locked-mode` with NU1004 (SR-012 / threat N7). Bump this deliberately and regenerate the lock files in the same commit.
